move: Move with {move_left} and {move_right}. Keep going and Tato breaks into a run!
jump: Press {jump} to jump. Hold it longer to jump higher.
flap: In the air, press {jump} again to flap, up to three times. Hold it to glide down slowly.
honk: Press {attack} to HONK! A honk bops creatures right in front of Tato.
stomp: Jump on top of most creatures to bop them. Not the spiky ones!
power: Touch a food bowl to get its power. {attack} now uses that power.
swap: One power at a time: a new food bowl replaces the old power, with a Flavor Burst!
hearts: Bumps cost a heart. Out of hearts? Tato just pops back at the last checkpoint bell.
checkpoint: Ring the checkpoint bell. It fills Tato's hearts and saves the game.
notes: Three Treasure Notes hide in every stage. Look off the main path!
qblock: Bump a Question Block from below, or hit it with an attack.
spring: Spring pads and bouncy mushrooms send Tato flying. Hold {jump} to go higher.
drop: On thin platforms, hold {move_down} and press {jump} to drop through.
swim: Tato floats! Paddle left and right, and press {jump} to hop out.
goal: Reach the big flag to finish the stage.
key: A key opens one locked block. Walk into the lock while carrying it.
button: Step on a button to move a platform or lower a bridge.
apples: Wobbling apples are about to fall. Wait, then go!
conveyor: Candy belts carry Tato along. Run against them to stay put.
ice: Ice is slippery. Slow down before a ledge!
wind: Gusts push Tato along. Glide with {jump} held to ride them far.
bridge: The drawbridge is up. Find its button or lever.
boss: Watch for the boss's warning flash, dodge, then attack while it rests.
hub_book: The Snack Notebook remembers every power, burst and creature.
hub_gate: Each picture is a world. Walk up and press {move_up} to visit.
hub_trial: The Trial Room has every power you have found. Try them all!
hub_wardrobe: Spend coins on something nice to wear.
